title: Fix 282
acceptance_criteria: chough checkpoint --pr 150 and --pr with a pull request URL each set the session's pr field, which another process reads back; an empty value clears it; a value with a line break, or one holding a local path or a token, is refused with the session file byte-identical, or redacted under --redact, as the pr field's existing guard does. Setting it adds no Timeline entry, as --objective and --title do not.

answers.constraints: Leif's decision on #282 (2026-11-18 planning interview) adds chough checkpoint --pr <number or URL> with the existing pr validation; his later answer 'No Timeline entry' makes it like --objective and --title, cli only. Human gates as plain text in tasks.md; deltas frozen at approval. No other lesson or principle constrains it.
